title: Savory Khichdi Fried Rice
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on the traditional Indian khichdi dish, featuring crispy fried rice and savory flavors.

ingredients.name: tender
ingredients.notes: sliced or chopped vegetables (e.g., carrots, peas)

ingredients.name: indian
ingredients.notes: curry powder or Indian spice blend

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced or chopped tender vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet. Crack an egg into the other side of the skillet and scramble it until cooked through.
Mix the egg with the vegetables.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the khichdi, jammy sauce, and Indian spice blend to the rice mixture.
Stir-fry everything together for about 5 minutes, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the Savory Khichdi Fried Rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds, if desired.
